null_hypothesis: At least one registered article statistic cannot be recovered within its declared tolerance after source-compatible inputs and generated artifacts exist.
alternative_hypothesis: All registered article statistics are recovered within their declared tolerances after source-compatible inputs and generated artifacts exist.
interpret_if_supported: The computational replication recovers the registered article statistics.
interpret_if_unsupported: A completed source-compatible attempt fails to recover at least one registered article statistic within tolerance.
interpret_if_inconclusive: The replication is blocked by missing inputs or generated artifacts; do not label it non-reproducible.

null_hypothesis: The short-rate factor does not improve pricing-error performance relative to registered comparator models by the materiality bounds.
alternative_hypothesis: The short-rate factor improves pricing-error performance relative to registered comparator models by the materiality bounds.
direction_or_equivalence_bounds: RMSE improvement at least 10 percent and maximum absolute pricing-error improvement at least 0.25 monthly percentage points
interpret_if_supported: The short-rate factor has economically meaningful incremental pricing content in the baseline sample.
interpret_if_unsupported: The baseline does not support an economically meaningful incremental pricing claim.
interpret_if_inconclusive: The pricing result is blocked, weakly identified, or too imprecise for interpretation.

null_hypothesis: Post-publication estimates fail sign compatibility, economic-magnitude compatibility, or pricing-error performance relative to the frozen baseline and comparator models.
alternative_hypothesis: Post-publication estimates are sign compatible with the baseline, economically comparable under the predeclared bounds, and do not deteriorate relative to the frozen baseline and comparator models.
direction_or_equivalence_bounds: risk-price sign compatible; risk-price change within 0.25 monthly percentage points; RMSE deterioration no more than 10 percent
interpret_if_supported: The short-rate pricing relation generalizes beyond the publication sample under the registered standard.
interpret_if_unsupported: The extension does not support temporal generalization of the baseline pricing relation.
interpret_if_inconclusive: The extension evidence is blocked, weakly identified, or too imprecise to classify.

null_hypothesis: At least one stability dimension exceeds its numerical equivalence bound across predeclared regimes.
alternative_hypothesis: Factor construction, portfolio betas, risk prices, pricing errors, and interpretable fit remain within their numerical equivalence bounds across predeclared regimes.
direction_or_equivalence_bounds: risk-price change within 0.25 monthly percentage points; beta-dispersion change within 25 percent; RMSE deterioration no more than 10 percent; maximum absolute pricing-error deterioration within 0.25 monthly percentage points; fit deterioration within 0.10 when interpretable
interpret_if_supported: The short-rate pricing relation is economically stable across registered regimes.
interpret_if_unsupported: The relation is regime dependent under the predeclared equivalence standard.
interpret_if_inconclusive: The confidence region is too wide or inputs are unavailable, so invariance cannot be claimed.

null_hypothesis: The short-rate beta column lacks enough cross-sectional dispersion, rank contribution, or robust identification to support a pricing interpretation.
alternative_hypothesis: The short-rate beta column passes the predeclared dispersion, rank, singular-value, and robust-inference diagnostics.
direction_or_equivalence_bounds: passes dispersion, rank, singular-value, condition, spanning, and robust-inference gates
interpret_if_supported: A risk-price estimate can be interpreted subject to the pricing-error tests.
interpret_if_unsupported: A statistically priced factor is not economically interpretable because identification is weak.
interpret_if_inconclusive: The diagnostics are unavailable or point in different directions.

null_hypothesis: Estimated unknown breaks do not align with economically meaningful policy boundaries.
alternative_hypothesis: Estimated unknown breaks align with one or more economically meaningful policy boundaries.
interpret_if_supported: Break dates suggest where regime definitions should be stress tested, not a confirmatory stability result.
interpret_if_unsupported: Break tests do not motivate a regime reinterpretation.
interpret_if_inconclusive: Break evidence is too sparse or sensitive to boundary choices.

null_hypothesis: Announcement-based policy and information components add no usable pricing content or fail component-level strength diagnostics.
alternative_hypothesis: At least one announcement-based component adds pricing content and passes component-level strength diagnostics.
direction_or_equivalence_bounds: optional only; requires event-source terms, monthly aggregation artifacts, and component weak-factor diagnostics
interpret_if_supported: The optional decomposition may motivate a separate paper or appendix extension.
interpret_if_unsupported: The decomposition does not add usable evidence to the current paper.
interpret_if_inconclusive: The event data, component labels, monthly aggregation, or diagnostics are unavailable.
